newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Tajik president hurt in assassination bid-Interfax.
newsitem.headline: Tajik president hurt in assassination bid-Interfax.

text.p: Tajik President Imomali Rakhmonov was wounded in an assassination attempt in the Central Asian state on Wednesday, Interfax news agency quoted presidential press secretary Zafar Saidov as saying.
Interfax quoted Saidov as saying Rakhmonov's life was not in danger. It gave no immediate details of the attack except to say it happened early on Wednesday.
Itar-Tass news agency said the attack was in the Leninabad region and was carried out with a grenade. It quoted regional officials as saying Rakhmonov had been injured in the leg.
Both news agencies said an attacker had been detained.
Tajikistan, a former Soviet republic, is still reeling from a four-year civil war in which tens of thousands of people were killed. Armed groups still roam the mountain state.
